data.rationale: The proposal gets the core procedure right: search the venue, pick the event (with an optional date), set start and end times, apply an optional amenity filter and click Update Search. It misses the sort parameter and the Sort-by step, and it ends by reviewing prices instead of clicking Book Now, so it is not quite complete for automation.
